device_state_and_mapping.state: binary cross-coupled 6T SRAM; signed INT8 two-complement weights
device_state_and_mapping.mapping: Each tile stores all 128 inputs for a distinct 16-output group. Tiles execute serially. No weight or input payload replication is counted.

cycle_semantics.compute_slot: full local SRAM/NOR/HCA/BFA MAC clock with sign handling and accumulation; extra_read_ns=0 is covered, not instantaneous
cycle_semantics.stream_boundary: one common digital tick for whole-vector capture plus one common digital tick for final 128-result commit; no cross-vector overlap
cycle_semantics.memory_slot: command, address and all 128-bit data captured at a rising edge; decode/BL drive/WL/write flip/recovery inside complete memory cycle; state compute-ready at next admissible edge
cycle_semantics.write_control_substitution: full memory slot replaces common T_front for this one-beat transaction; no separately charged task handshake
cycle_semantics.compute_memory_exclusion: no overlap assumed; one controller services only one operation/tile at a time

method_issues.finding: existing R4 and shared operation composition fully express this case; included-stage coverage must be recorded explicitly at call sites
method_issues.impact: feeding a full synchronous cycle into a physical-update-only argument without applying R4 would double-count controls; this is a usage constraint, not an inability of the common method
method_issues.resolution: local adapter calls shared dcim_service with bundled MAC clock and zero boundary; shared program_sequence_ns adds only unmatched boundary; direct geometry from shared direct_service and full memory service composed with zero front

method_issues.finding: dcim read_rounds conflates repeated service slots with actual WL switching when SRAM static access persists over bit slices
method_issues.impact: D6 has512 MAC slots but64 row-group activations; no numerical difference when extra read is covered
method_issues.resolution: store both numbers; do not misuse read_reuse_input_slices, which requires an added latch while D6 uses static cell connection

method_issues.finding: logical shape and active resource shape determine rounds; full macro cycles cannot move unchanged between16 and128outputs or16 and32terms
method_issues.impact: D6 native64 clocks becomes512; R0 remains256 under different resources
method_issues.resolution: native mapping and conditional R0 sensitivity are separately recorded

method_issues.finding: cross-chip complete write cycle transfer is the largest evidence gap
method_issues.impact: CMOS-07 is48-bit8T at1.05V eFlash, D6 is128-bit6T; t_mem is reference choice, not measured D6write
method_issues.resolution: retain source conditions, include6T transient-success evidence; no PVT-guarantee or fabricated-pair claim; extra-handshake and write-time sensitivities show effect
